hooks.command: cmux claude-hook idle < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; cmux notify --title 'Claude Code' --body '입력 대기 중' 2>/dev/null; osascript -e 'display notification "입력을 기다리고 있습니다" with title "Claude Code" sound name "Submarine"' 2>/dev/null; true

cmux notify --title 'Claude Code' --subtitle '권한 요청' --body '승인이 필요합니다' 2>/dev/null; osascript -e 'display notification "승인이 필요합니다" with title "Claude Code" subtitle "Permission" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null; true
cmux claude-hook stop < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude '완료' --icon sparkle --color '#34c759' 2>/dev/null; true
cmux claude-hook session-start < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude '실행 중' --icon sparkle --color '#007aff' 2>/dev/null; cmux log --level info --source claude '세션 시작' 2>/dev/null; true
cmux claude-hook prompt-submit < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; cmux set-status claude '작업 중' --icon sparkle --color '#ff9500' 2>/dev/null; true
